scene_purpose: Give Ilyra and Maevra a private scene between two women who already know one another well while Ilyra changes Maevra's splint. The medical task grounds Maevra's continuing broken-arm state and healing-magic limits; their established friendship allows ordinary adult curiosity about Maevra and Torren without turning Ilyra into a therapist, relationship analyst, or exposition device. The scene may reveal only the current Chapter-1 ceiling: Torren is more than an ordinary colleague to Maevra and matters to her personally.

required_character_truths: Maevra's arm was broken during the Broken Convoy attack before Chapter 1 and remains broken.
Ilyra's magic can ease pain and surrounding strain but cannot mend the fracture.
Ilyra and Maevra already have established personal familiarity; their ease is not created in this scene.
Ilyra asks about Maevra and Torren out of ordinary adult curiosity, gossip, teasing or genuine interest, not as therapist, mediator, moral referee or relationship diagnostician.
The player should already be able to tell that Maevra and Torren have known each other for a long time because of practiced arguing, shorthand, remembered habits, and mutual stubbornness.
Their Chapter-1 surface dynamic can resemble an old married couple who may not even seem to get along particularly well.
Maevra is stubborn about duty and responsibility; Torren is stubborn about ground truth, routes, practical judgment, and refusing to pretend a bad plan is good.
This scene may reveal only that Torren is more than an ordinary colleague to Maevra and that he matters to her personally.
Exact duration, enlistment ages, former romance, sex, breakup history, repeated reunions, current romantic status, and Torren's private feelings remain unrevealed.
Both women may swear naturally according to their current adult speech habits; the scene does not need sanitized medical or friendship dialogue.
